hook_structure: curiosity-gap + age-shock framing: anonymized 'this kid' teaser -> escalating dollar-figure card -> reveal he's still underage/in-school, priming a rags-to-riches insider story

beats.cutaway_subject: blurred/pixelated face of a teen boy sitting in a gaming chair at a desk, tilted phone-photo framing
beats.read: counts up the dollar figure live over a mystery-blurred subject to bait curiosity before any identity is given.

beats.cutaway_subject: blurry motion-swipe transition into a graduation-photo polaroid of the same boy
beats.card_text: but hasn't even graduated high school
beats.read: the whip-pan/blur cut hides the reveal edit and the polaroid card delivers the age-shock twist that recontextualizes the big number.

beats.card_text: at 13 years / Zach / Zach Yadegari / built a
beats.read: cut to talking-head interview establishes the narrator and stamps the subject's name/age as word-by-word captions track his speech.

beats.cutaway_subject: app icon grid screenshot of 'Totally Science' game platform, then padlock 3D icon, then a laptop showing a browser game
beats.card_text: Totally Science / [description of gaming platform bypassing school filters] / it led / bypass school restrictions / and play games on their laptop
beats.read: a run of graphic cards and 3D icon animations illustrates the first product (school-game site) purely visually while VO explains it, no talking head needed.
returns to the interview to pivot the story from the first venture to what came next, marked by a single-word transition card.

beats.card_text: he sold this / $100K / he / the profits / and / made an app
beats.read: rapid word-by-word captions keep pace with speech to sell the sale price and pivot into the new venture without any cutaways, letting the number ($100K) hit hard on its own beat.

beats.cutaway_subject: black app-icon tile with white apple graphic, then phone mockup showing 'Cal AI' nutrition-scanning app UI with a pancake photo and calorie count, then app dashboard screen
beats.read: cuts away from the interview to product-demo phone mockups so the viewer sees the actual app (Cal AI) being described, grounding the claim in visible proof.
back on the speaker for the big reveal number, the '$20' card intentionally under-delivers for a half-second before snapping to the full '$20,000,000' figure as a comedic/dramatic beat.
a hard cut to a different setting/interview (dark curtain backdrop) signals a new source or timeframe with minimal captioning, a quieter connective beat.
brief uncaptioned cut to a third location keeps momentum without adding new information, functioning as a visual palate-cleanser.

beats.card_text: he explained to / how / can / can do this / with / 0 / 0 coding experience
beats.read: big oversized '0' graphic isolates the most surprising fact (no coding background) as its own visual beat before the explanatory text catches up.
short connective caption signals another point is coming without yet cutting away, sustaining the interview's momentum.

beats.cutaway_subject: blue 'TOP SECRET' folder icon animating, then floating question-mark icons with dollar amounts and an unrevealed app-store mockup
beats.card_text: TOP SECRET / making anything go viral / and a few other / multi-million dollar app ideas / $9,876,234.00 / $15,876,129.00 / $2,872,678.00 / $4,453,768.00
beats.read: mystery-box graphic treatment (blurred question marks, redacted folder) visually withholds the secret while stacking dollar figures to build anticipation for a CTA.

beats.card_text: that / have / have the time / to work on / if you / full / full conversation / comment / the word / and "App" / to "App" / right now "App"
beats.read: returns to interview for the direct-address CTA, word-paced captions building the exact comment instruction the viewer must follow.
screen dims to near-black and an Instagram icon pulses/glows over the frozen final CTA, visually pushing the viewer toward the follow/comment action as the video ends.
